prompt: A low-poly 3D floating island: a small chunk of land built from faceted, flat-shaded polygons with crisp edges, its rocky underside tapering to a point, hovering in empty space. On the island: A weathered wooden wharf deck bathed in bright coastal afternoon sun. At the center, two round sourdough bread bowls of clam chowder sit on a rustic picnic bench. Leaning over the sturdy wooden railing are two figures in windbreakers, peering down at two plump brown sea lions perched on timber beams below. On the left, two colorful cruiser bikes rest against the rail. The sun casts sharp, warm shadows across the splintered gray planks. Clean stylized game-asset look: every element, including people, furniture, food and plants, is built from flat-shaded faceted polygons in soft pastel colors, with no realistic textures. The whole world is one compact object, centered, filling about two thirds of the frame with empty space on every side, seen from a three-quarter angle slightly above. Nothing extends beyond its edges: no horizon, sky or distant scenery behind it. Plain seamless pale gray background with nothing else in it. Soft, even, diffuse light with only a gentle contact shadow; everything in crisp focus. No text, letters, numbers, signs or logos anywhere.
